fixes.new:
A cone-shaped Space Monster. Its interior houses a large number of soldiers.
It normally clings densely, like thorns, to the surface of a Cruiser-class, but upon spotting an enemy, it detaches from the Cruiser-class and charges forward at high acceleration. The instant it pierces its target, it releases the soldiers within to overwhelm it; this is its method of attack.
Multi-stage boosters are fitted to its rear, increasing the force of its charge.
fixes.reason: omission/mistranslation: the Japanese says it is packed tightly (bisshiri) onto the Cruiser-class body like thorns (plural); 'like a thorn' dropped the density and number

fixes.new:
The individuals that form the core of the Space Monsters.
Starting with individuals of this size, they are capable of independent warp.
They can move at near-light speed, and are equipped with light spheres and giant fireball cannons capable of sinking even a space battleship in a single blow, making them a threat even alone. In addition to this, they attack while releasing large numbers of soldiers.
Among individuals of this size, the type known as the high-speed type is somewhat smaller than other individuals of the same class and inferior in firepower, but boasts high mobility. A large-capacity cooling organ that trails in the ether current is attached to its rear.
fixes.reason: mistranslation/omission: 'kono saizu no kotai kara' = starting from individuals of this size (lower bound lost); 'kyodai na kakyuu-hou' = giant fireball cannons ('cannon' dropped)

fixes.new:
The ultimate Buster Machine created by human civilization, into which $$ノノ$$ transformed after regaining her memories.
She lived in the form of $$ノノ$$, but transforms into $$バスターマシン７号$$ following the incident on Titan.
She is the entity that rules the $$バスター軍団$$, which had been called Space Monsters, and the Space Force calls her the 'Goddess of the Solar System' and the 'Queen of the Space Monsters.'
Even after regaining her memories and becoming a Buster Machine, the innocent and cheerful personality that $$ノノ$$ had is unchanged, and she continues to adore $$ラルク$$.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says she lived in Nono's form (ノノの姿で生活していた); 'in that form' pointed back to the Buster Machine form of sentence 1, reversing the sense. Pronouns: Nono is female (glossary pilot 218; the text itself says goddess/queen), the old rule avoided pronouns, so 'her memories' and she/her are restored

fixes.new:
The ultimate Buster Machine created by human civilization, into which $$ノノ$$ transformed after regaining her memories.
She lived in the form of $$ノノ$$, but transforms into $$バスターマシン７号$$ following the incident on Titan.
She is the entity that rules the $$バスター軍団$$, which had been called Space Monsters, and the Space Force calls her the 'Goddess of the Solar System' and the 'Queen of the Space Monsters.'
Even after regaining her memories and becoming a Buster Machine, the innocent and cheerful personality that $$ノノ$$ had is unchanged, and she continues to adore $$ラルク$$.
In addition, by being stored in the head of the aggregate of Buster Machines, she can also become '$$ダイバスター$$.'
To save humanity from the greatest crisis in the universe, the collapse of the black hole that occurred in the final battle, she departed to the other side of the singularity.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says she lived in Nono's form (ノノの姿で生活していた); 'in that form' pointed back to the Buster Machine form of sentence 1, reversing the sense. Pronouns: Nono is female (glossary pilot 218; the text itself says goddess/queen), the old rule avoided pronouns, so 'her memories' and she/her are restored (same fix in DSC2; shared sentences kept consistent)
